rows.en: Touya: "Phew! That was a good meal..."
Leone: "Oh, Touya! Hey, hey, show me around!"
Leone: "I said, show me around the Liebhofen."
Leone: "Why not? That much should be fine.
Have you got something aboard you don't want me to see?"
Touya: "Oh! C-Captain... How long have you been there?"
Touya: "Oh, he's in charge of this ship."
Leone: "Hmm. Now that you mention it, he does have a commanding presence.
Oh, right. I'm interested in this ship.
Could I have a look around?"
You can't change your mind and say no later, okay?"
Leone: "Thank you! Touya, we have permission!"
Touya: "...I don't think that's what he meant..."
Touya: "Hey, don't grab my arm! Don't cling to me!"
Leone: "It's fine. We're close, aren't we?"
Leone: "Wow, it really is huge. The fact that something this big
can fly just shows how far technology's come."
Touya: "What's with the sudden serious reflection?
Sure, you probably haven't seen one this big,
but you've seen similar things, haven't you?"
So this is the Liebhofen's nerve center!"
Ymir: "Um... Please don't fiddle with the instruments too much."
Ymir: 'I heard from the captain. But stop at a reasonable point.
This ship is classified, after all,
and it isn't something we can decide about on our own.'
Ymir: 'It'll be a handful, but please take care of it.'
Leone: "Hey, what are you whispering about?"
Leone: "So there's a place like this too...
Touya: "Hey, let's make this the last stop."
Touya: "Don't 'aww' me. How am I supposed to show you
every part of a ship this ridiculously huge?"
I've got a rough idea of the layout now,
so I should be fine on my own...'
Leone: "Doesn't this feel a bit like a date?"
Touya: "W-What?! Just when I was wondering what you'd say..."
Touya: "Hey! Don't say things that'll give people the wrong idea!"
Touya: "I'm done. Do what you want."
Yamato: "Was it okay to leave Leone behind?"
Touya: "Well, she probably won't do anything reckless. She'll be fine."
Touya: "You're only aboard temporarily, you know.
If you won't follow the rules, I can have you off the ship right now."
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:19:0C>I just have to behave, right?! Bleh!"
Touya: "...Honestly, you're like a little kid."
